name: pr-watcher
description: A pane that watches your open pull requests, your review requests and any PR you add by hand.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the pane asks GitHub for fresh data. 10 at least.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Raise a toast and a native notification when someone else comments on, reviews, pushes to, merges or closes a listed pull request, and when CI finishes on yours.
